{{Quote|Some warriors become scourges of evil, living weapons who serve the light. Others become stalwart defenders, guardians who protect and shield others.|Nimi|<ref name="Advanced" />}}
'''Nimi''' was<ref name="Advanced" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Color/Legends|Olive-skinned]] and largely bald, Nimi wore their remaining black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] in a knot behind their head. Theyhad blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]], and wore tan and white [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]]. An acquaintance of Master [[Orgus Din]], Nimi was aboard [[Carrick Station]]<ref name="Advanced" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> when Din's [[Hero of Tython|former Padawan]]&mdash;just elevated to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;arrived on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. Nimi discussed the Jedi's potential with the Knight, but advised the Jedi to choose one of two disciplines: the path of either the [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]] or the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]]. Recognizing both disciplines' benefits, Nimi instructed the Knight to speak with Master [[Cassa Hun]] for further training. Nimi also spent [[Time/Legends|time]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Advanced" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nimi introduces the mission "Advanced Training: Jedi Knight" for Jedi Knight players who have just completed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Nimi can be found on both Carrick Station and Coruscant, but this article assumes the player spoke to Nimi at the first opportunity to do so.<ref name="Advanced" />
